svg.text: Crescent Bay with the Sovereign run bow-first out of the curve: its three pieces cross the bay to the mouth, a harbor north of it and a lagoon of flats south.
Open hub at the root: the town in the bow, a ring road north
to the docks and cliffs, south to the beaches. The wreck is the
only way across the bay, inside, all the way out to the launch.
Train into the station in the beached bow
Port missions round both halves of the bay
Win the marker: the Gilded Parlor, in the bow
Through the wreck to the stern's launch stage
Board by the starboard gangway, under fire
a bounty on the launch stage

g.text: THE GILDED LILY · THE DECKS WE PLAY
true scale: 180 m long, 24 m across · bow to the right · Ned's crew are hostile from the first step aboard
UPPER DECKS · promenade, lifeboats, funnels, bridge

svg.text: BOARDING · NED'S CREW KNOW YOU: HOSTILE FROM THE FIRST STEP
THE LAUNCH RIDE OUT, AT DUSK
wall for cover; more crew come
Then push forward to the bridge.
